note: Adult external measurements used to check fauna meshes. Ranges are [low, high] as published; units are in each key. A species is added only with a primary source.

source.citation: Meagher, M. (1986). Bison bison. Mammalian Species 266: 1-8. American Society of Mammalogists.
source.location: General characters, p. 1: measurements for males and females, compiled from Hall (1981), Meagher (1973) and Seton (1929)

context: Maximum recorded mass 1724 kg, a semidomestic bull (Meagher 1986, citing Hebbring 1978).
Hair length on shoulders and hump 65 to 160 mm, chaps 150 to 190 mm, beard about 300 mm (Meagher 1986), so a furred mesh silhouette can stand above skin-level measurements.
Condylobasal skull length 519 mm for one adult male (YNP 11661) and 460 mm for one adult female (YNP 12050); single specimens, not ranges.
